description: Defines the ExtendedDisplayIdentification class and related nested classes for handling EDID data, including parsing display info, color formats, and EDID segments.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification
classes.description: Represents extended display identification data, including parsing and validation of EDID segments and display info.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification::Buffer
classes.description: Manages a fixed-size buffer for EDID data, supporting copying and pointer conversions.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification::Iterator
classes.description: Iterates over EDID segment buffers, providing validation and navigation.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification::CEA
classes.description: Handles CEA extension blocks within EDID, parsing data blocks for video, audio, vendor-specific info, and color formats.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the EDID base data is valid based on specific header bytes.

methods.name: Raw
methods.description: Copies raw EDID data into provided buffer.

methods.name: Manufacturer
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer code from EDID base data.

methods.name: ProductCode
methods.description: Returns the product code from EDID base data.

methods.name: Serial
methods.description: Returns the serial number from EDID base data.

methods.name: Week
methods.description: Returns the manufacturing week of the display.

methods.name: Year
methods.description: Returns the manufacturing year of the display.

methods.name: Major
methods.description: Returns the major version of EDID.

methods.name: Minor
methods.description: Returns the minor version of EDID.

methods.name: Digital
methods.description: Indicates if the display is digital.

methods.name: BitsPerColor
methods.description: Returns bits per color supported by the display.

methods.name: ColorDepth
methods.description: Returns the color depth supported.

methods.name: DisplayType
methods.description: Returns display type and color format info.

methods.name: VideoInterface
methods.description: Returns the video interface type.

methods.name: Extensions
methods.description: Returns an iterator over EDID extension segments.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the EDID base data.

methods.name: Segments
methods.description: Returns the number of EDID segments.

methods.name: Segment
methods.description: Accesses a specific EDID segment buffer.

methods.name: CEASegment
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the CEA extension segment.

methods.name: WidthInCentimeters
methods.description: Returns display width in centimeters.

methods.name: HeightInCentimeters
methods.description: Returns display height in centimeters.

methods.name: PreferredWidthInPixels
methods.description: Returns preferred display width in pixels.

methods.name: PreferredHeightInPixels
methods.description: Returns preferred display height in pixels.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets EDID data to default state.
